title: Narrative review
description: What someone took away from watching, answered without sight of the plan. The value of this artifact depends entirely on the reviewer never having read the scene graph: an agent shown the intent will confirm the intent.

product.description: What is this a video for? Name it as the video names it, or say you could not tell.

problem.description: What problem does it claim to solve?

proof.description: What evidence was actually shown, as opposed to asserted.

scenes.description: One line per distinct moment you could make out, in order.

unsupported.description: Anything stated that nothing on screen backed up.

silent.description: Could the story be followed with the sound off?

readable.description: Anything you could not read in the time it was on screen.

ending.description: What is a convinced viewer meant to do next?

confusions.description: Anything that actively misled you. The most useful field here.
